visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: A Partial Match Counts as a Match
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Searching for abd in abcabd should print 3, but the program prints 0.

solution.explanation: A match exists only when the inner loop has consumed the entire pattern, which is when pattern[j] is the terminator. j > 0 only says that the first character matched, so a partial match is accepted too early.
